title: Personalized Constitutionally-Aligned Agentic Superego: Secure AI Behavior Aligned to Diverse Human Values
reasoning: The paper introduces and benchmarks a framework specifically designed to align AI agent behavior with religious guidelines (e.g., Halachic laws, Shabbat observance, Halal dietary laws, Hindu principles) and ethical rule sets (Universal Ethical Floor), using these as core components of its 'Creed Constitutions'.
